planets.name: TOI-1453 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1453 with a 6.59-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-1453 c was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1453. Its orbit and size follow Stalport et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
